Name: Live Nation Estonia
Description: The Estonian branch of the world's leading live entertainment company, organizing major international arena and stadium concerts.

Name: Eesti Kontsert
Description: Estonia's largest state concert organizer, managing several major concert halls and producing a wide range of classical and contemporary music events.

Name: Tallinn Music Week (Shiftworks)
Description: An international new music showcase and city culture festival that serves as a major networking hub for the creative industries in the Baltic region.

Name: Jazzkaar
Description: The largest jazz festival in the Baltic States, featuring world-class international artists and promoting local jazz talent since 1990.

Name: WOW Events
Description: A leading event marketing agency specializing in high-impact corporate events, conferences, and internal communication solutions.

Name: Orangetime Event
Description: A professional event management company focused on strategic planning and creative execution for corporate meetings and conventions.

Name: Miltton Events
Description: A communication-focused agency that delivers world-class live, virtual, and hybrid events for both public and private sectors.

Name: Estonian National Opera
Description: Estonia's premier theater for opera, ballet, and operetta, hosting a diverse repertoire of classical and contemporary productions.

Name: Tallinn Song Festival Grounds
Description: An iconic national venue that hosts the historic Estonian Song Festival as well as major outdoor concerts and exhibitions.

Name: PÖFF (Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival)
Description: One of the largest film festivals in Northern Europe and the only FIAPF-accredited competitive feature film festival in the region.

Name: Frank Events
Description: A full-service event planning company specializing in corporate summer days, Christmas parties, and strategic team-building activities.

Name: Blue Drum Events
Description: A creative destination management company (DMC) that produces unconventional and humorous corporate events and theatrical tours.

Name: Alexela Concert Hall
Description: A multifunctional, world-class concert hall in the heart of Tallinn that hosts international conferences, galas, and musical performances.

Name: Unibet Arena
Description: Estonia's best-known indoor multipurpose arena, hosting large-scale concerts, sports events, and trade fairs.

Name: Vanemuine Theatre
Description: Estonia's oldest theater, located in Tartu, offering a unique three-genre repertoire including drama, opera, and ballet.
